payload.goal: Design one to two binder candidates against 6MRR, assess sequence quality and binding affinity, then rank.
assumptions: The 6MRR PDB provides a suitable receptor target for binder diffusion.
pxdesign in pipeline mode is sufficient to generate sequenced, scored binder candidates in a single step.
Sequence analysis and PRODIGY binding affinity constitute adequate basic structural quality evaluation.
A top-2 ranking is sufficient given the small candidate count.

missing_inputs.name: target_chain
missing_inputs.reason: Chain ID of the receptor in 6MRR.pdb is not provided; pxdesign requires this field.

missing_inputs.name: binder_length
missing_inputs.reason: Desired binder residue count is not specified; pxdesign requires this field.

missing_inputs.name: chain_a
missing_inputs.reason: Target chain identifier for PRODIGY interface scoring is not known at planning time.

missing_inputs.name: chain_b
missing_inputs.reason: Designed binder chain identifier for PRODIGY interface scoring is not known at planning time.

nodes.intent: Generate binder backbone and sequence candidates conditioned on the 6MRR target using minimal diffusion samples.
Assess sequence-level biochemical properties and liabilities of designed binder candidates.
Estimate protein-protein binding affinity (deltaG, Kd) at the target-binder interface using the predicted complex.
Aggregate sequence QC and affinity scores into a deterministic top-2 ranked candidate list.

finalization.ranking_preference: prefer candidates with favorable predicted binding affinity and low sequence liabilities
